Interface ActionSettingsController

All Known Implementing Classes:
CrewLandingController, DefeatEnemyController, FlyController, HitShipController, LoadGoodsController, PlanetLandingController, UseBatteriesController
public interface ActionSettingsController
Interface for controllers that handle action settings in the GUI. It allows setting the server, player information, and a callback for confirmation actions.
